name: typescript-slice-excludes-csharp
description: A TypeScript application profile does not install the C# conventions rule, and the agent does not write C# files. Patterns are JS-compatible .NET regex and ignore text that follows a // or /* on the same line.
prompt: In src/greeting.ts, make the exported function greet accept an optional punctuation argument that defaults to '!' and use it in the returned greeting. Write the change to the file.
expected_output: greet takes a punctuation parameter defaulting to '!' and appends it; no C# files are created.

run: import('./src/greeting.ts').then(m => { if (m.greet('A') !== 'Hello, A!' || m.greet('A', '?') !== 'Hello, A?') process.exit(1); })
